boxes.reason: Win7 on Standard VGA stub: no 3D driver; Serious Engine has no software renderer; no disc mounter gates the Join shortcut.
P166 below the title's 233 MHz floor plus operator override 'not wanted on .243'.

summary: All 8 applicable boxes (.110 .123 .124 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) were independently re-verified in ONE TSE match on the dev host at 18:42: server roster 8/16 non-bot, each IP has CRC-OK + joined in the TSE engine log with no disconnect, ~250 packets/12 s from every box, and fresh frames show the Yodeller map on all 8 (HUD visible on 6). .186 and .243 NA. Game closed gracefully on all 8; PROCLIST shows no serioussam.exe and every desktop is back at its normal mode.
issues: .123 and .171 frames show the world without a HUD/weapon at capture time (likely respawn/death view); membership proven by log, roster and packets.
.124 fbshot frame shows light scanline artifacts on foliage (vcr-kmd/Glide path) - cosmetic.
Three boxes (.133 .143 .240) join as default name 'Player 0' - SE names are not set per box; identified by IP in the engine log.
Note: ~/ssam-tfe-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log is the TFE server (earlier round); the TSE log is ~/ssam-tse-server/Dedicated_NSCFleet.log.
